 Litigation News CAT denies relief to IPS officer accused of misusing Patna HC Chief Justice's name to pressure officials 
 The tribunal refused to quash disciplinary proceedings initiated against the accused IPS officer. Police Officer AI Image S N Thyagarajan Published on :  23 Oct 2026, 7:34 am 2 min read 
 Copied 
 Follow Us The Patna Bench of the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) has refused to quash disciplinary proceedings against Bihar cadre Indian Police Service (IPS) officer Aditya Kumar, who is accused of involvement in a conspiracy to impersonate a former Chief Justice of the Patna High Court to influence senior police officials [ Aditya Kumar v. UOI ].
